# Finished U.S. economic briefing

Download [briefing.html](briefing.html) and open it in a browser. This is the complete offline analyst report produced from the retained official UNRATE, CPIAUCSL and GDP public tables. The original data, comparisons, source metadata and local report downloads are embedded.

The report selects January 2024 through September 2026: 75 observations and 150 exact comparisons. It retains all 103 original current/baseline observations required by those comparisons. Source missing values remain visible.

Files:

- [briefing.html](briefing.html): complete offline report.
- [briefing-measures.csv](briefing-measures.csv): all comparison rows, original values, dates, units, time basis and calculation states.
- [briefing.json](briefing.json): complete report model with original observations and source metadata.
- [briefing-manifest.json](briefing-manifest.json): original source/review/report binding and exact report file hashes.
- [macro-source.capture.json](macro-source.capture.json): complete native import containing all 2,219 original observations and all three publisher table texts.
- [review.json](review.json): original review selection and projection.
- [review-note.txt](review-note.txt): exact note bytes for reproducing the same review ID.

Follow [BRIEFINGS.md](../../BRIEFINGS.md) to import this source, recreate the saved report, publish its native merchant assets, use the existing configured buyer and export/reopen the complete operator project. The report files were generated by the actual source/model/report functions; this directory is a ready report and complete source input for that native workflow.
